_note: Display-only overlay for tech-radar. radar.json is authoritative for ring/category/score/demand. This file adds rich descriptions and job_examples. Merged at render time by index.html.

RAG Pipeline.description: Top priority. Portfolio project shipped (ml-portfolio). FAISS + sentence-transformers + multi-LLM. 7 job appearances. Direct interview proof — show the GitHub link.

AI Model Evaluation / RLHF.description: Evaluation frameworks, benchmark design, human feedback loops. Gap: no production experience yet. High ROI to learn — differentiates ML engineers from 'prompt wrappers'.

Agentic AI Systems.description: LLM agents with tool use, planning, multi-step reasoning. Reviewed in Springer Nature book. Fast-moving — first movers get outsized credit.

LLM Prompt Engineering.description: Context design, RAG prompt templates, few-shot, chain-of-thought patterns. Already applied in ml-portfolio — formalise and market this skill explicitly.

LLM Inference Infrastructure.description: vLLM, TGI, Ollama at scale. Production model serving and batching. Strong infra angle — closest to your 15-year backend expertise. Gap but high ROI.

Vector Databases.description: FAISS used in RAG portfolio. Pinecone, ChromaDB for production. RAG dependency — you're already partially here. Deepen on managed options.

MLOps.description: ML CI/CD, model versioning, drift monitoring, reproducibility. Bridges your backend engineering discipline to ML systems. Closest to what you already do.

NLP Embeddings.description: sentence-transformers in use in RAG project. Semantic search, chunking strategies, embedding model selection. Deepen understanding from portfolio work.

LLM Fine-tuning / LoRA.description: LoRA, QLoRA, parameter-efficient fine-tuning. Declined NLP fine-tuning contract (good call — too early). Build understanding now so you can evaluate scope correctly next time.

LLM Integration Patterns.description: Enterprise LLM deployment patterns beyond basic RAG: function calling, structured outputs, multi-modal, streaming. Watch as the field matures past RAG hype.

MCP (Model Context Protocol).description: Anthropic standard for AI tool integration. 1 appearance but strategic override: early-mover advantage. Few engineers have hands-on MCP experience yet.

Azure.description: 5 appearances — highest cloud demand signal in EU AI/ML. AWS certified but Azure more prevalent in EU job market. Lead with Azure in applications targeting EU roles.

Python.description: 3 appearances. FastAPI, pandas, numpy, sentence-transformers in active use across portfolio projects. Don't undersell — market explicitly.

LLM APIs.description: Anthropic, OpenAI, Ollama used in ml-portfolio. You can deploy LLM integrations today. Market this actively — it's already a YES skill.

AWS.description: Solutions Architect certified (Apr 2024). EC2, Lambda, S3, SageMaker basics. Strong positioning for cloud-native AI infra roles.

Kubernetes.description: Credit Suisse deployment experience. Container orchestration for ML model serving at scale. Market for MLOps and ML platform roles.

Banking Domain.description: Citi, Deutsche Bank, Santander, Credit Suisse. Unique differentiator — most ML engineers lack financial domain expertise. Finance AI roles need both.

Solution Architecture.description: 15 years enterprise design experience. System design interviews, architecture docs, trade-off analysis. Market as production engineering discipline.

Spring AI.description: Springer Nature technical review — you reviewed production code using this. Java-native LLM integration. Niche differentiator for Java shops adopting AI.

Chatbot Integration.description: LLM-powered conversational AI deployment patterns. Enterprise chatbot architecture. Market alongside RAG portfolio.

FastAPI.description: Python REST API framework for ML model serving. Used across portfolio projects. Standard tool in ML engineering stack.

REST API Design.description: API design and implementation. Foundational across all engineering roles. Don't lead with it — it's table stakes.

CI/CD.description: Jenkins, GitHub Actions, deployment pipelines. ML pipeline deployment automation. Production engineering discipline — already practised.
resources: GitHub Actions in use across all repos

SQL.description: Relational databases, financial data querying. Foundational — market it quietly, don't lead with it for AI/ML roles.

MLflow.description: Experiment tracking, model registry, artifact store. Standard MLOps toolchain. Quick to learn — prioritise after RAG, model eval, and agentic AI.
resources: MLflow quickstart (1-2 days to basic proficiency)

AI-Assisted Development.description: GitHub Copilot, Claude Code — already using daily. Make it explicit in applications. Growing demand — but will be table stakes in 12 months.

Ollama.description: Local LLM runtime. Used in ml-portfolio for offline inference. Growing for enterprise air-gapped deployments. Already a YES skill.

Make.com / n8n.description: 2 appearances. Workflow automation for AI pipelines. Low-code. Monitor demand — may grow as non-technical AI adoption increases.

LangChain4j.description: Java LLM framework. Reviewed in Springer book. Java-native AI agent construction. Watch enterprise Java adoption curve.

Pinecone.description: Managed vector database. Production alternative to self-hosted FAISS. Assess before investing time — depends on target client stack.
resources: Compare: Pinecone vs Weaviate vs Qdrant

Kafka / Event Streaming.description: Santander Kafka Streams experience. Monitor for real-time ML inference patterns — streaming feature pipelines are a growing MLOps use case.

Java.description: 15 years production experience across Citi, Deutsche Bank, Santander, Credit Suisse. Your credibility anchor — but not your pitch for AI/ML roles. Mention as context, don't lead with it.
resources: Stop marketing as primary skill in AI/ML applications

Spring Boot.description: Core Java framework. Useful as bridge (Spring AI) but Spring Boot itself is not the story for AI/ML transition. Mention only as context.

Docker.description: Table stakes. Everyone has it. Not a differentiator for senior AI/ML roles. Mention in CV but don't lead with it.

Go (Golang).description: Xebia role required it. Hard dealbreaker gap. No investment — not aligned to Java→AI/ML transition path.

React / Node.js.description: Not your strength. Avoid full-stack roles entirely. If a role requires React, score 0 immediately.

PyTorch.description: Required for pure ML research. Not your target — MLOps/platform/backend+AI roles don't require this. Don't invest time.

TensorFlow.description: Deep learning framework. PyTorch more prevalent. Neither is your target direction. Deprioritise.
